exposure: Parity (nulliparous, parous, grand-multiparous, grand-grand multiparous, prior cesarean delivery)
outcome: Length of the second stage of labor
cohort: 100,759 women with singleton spontaneous vaginal deliveries between 2005-2017 at a tertiary medical center
finding: The median length of the second stage of labor was significantly longer in nulliparous women, especially with epidural use, compared to parous women, and was also influenced by factors like birth weight, gestational age, and induction of labor.
mod_finding: The length of the second stage of labor was significantly shorter in women delivering preterm compared to women delivering at term.
